# Branch Operations Optimization Review

This confidential bank document from the Operations department outlines critical areas for review and optimization.

## Key Operational Directives:

*   Review customer wait times on a quarterly basis.
*   Optimize the standard update process for customer wait times.
*   Urgently update teller performance metrics and standards.
*   Optimize overall branch efficiency in alignment with Strategy 2026.
*   Optimize the standard update process for cash flow.
